description: Every fixed line the family side can show, each with a script id (AGENTS.md section 6.4). Covered by the banned-phrase lint. Slots in braces are filled only with her name, a topic name, a member's name, counts, and dates. Changes need a second reviewer (section 13).

note_warm.text: Recall talked with {name} about {topic} this week. Want to give her a call?

note_gap.text: {topic} has no year yet. Do you remember one?

note_difference.text: {name} and {member} remember this differently. Want to call her about it?

note_pointer.text: There's a new note on {name}'s record.

record_header.text: This is a record of what happened in Recall calls, not a measure of {name}'s memory overall. Practice on a topic, call quality, and time of day all affect it.

record_unaided.text: {topic} - recalled unaided in {unaided} of {calls} recent calls.

record_after_cue.text: {topic} - recalled after a cue in {after_cue} of {calls} recent calls.

record_recognition.text: {topic} - needed a recognition prompt in {recognition} of {calls} recent calls.

change_topic.text: {topic} - recalled unaided in {recent} of the last {window} calls, compared with {earlier} of the {window} before.

change_summary.text: In recent Recall calls, more prompting was needed across several topics than in earlier calls. This is a record of Recall calls, not a clinical assessment. If you have concerns, you can export the record to share with a doctor.

export_note.text: This record is not a clinical assessment or diagnosis.

contribution_prompt.text: Tell Recall about a memory you share with {name}.

contribution_question_hint.text: This box is for telling Recall something you remember. To find out what {name} remembers, give her a call.

contribution_thanks.text: Thank you. Recall will gently ask {name} about it, in her own time.

receipt_context.text: {topic} - recalled after a little context in this call.

receipt_cue.text: {topic} - recalled after one contextual cue ({cue}) in this call.

receipt_recognition.text: {topic} - recalled with a recognition prompt in this call.

receipt_reorientation.text: {topic} - Recall shared the memory in this call.

receipt_stopped.text: The call was ended early. Nothing from it was kept.

receipt_safety.text: Recall stopped the call and sent a safety note to the designated caregiver.

thesis.text: Cues, not answers - every memory stays in her own words.
